jobs.title: Software Engineer, SystemML - AI Networking
jobs.description:
In this role, you will be a member of the AI Networking Software team and part of the bigger DC networking organization. The team develops and owns the software stack around NCCL (NVIDIA Collective Communications Library), which enables multi-GPU and multi-node data communication through HPC-style collectives. ------------------

Accessibility is one of the hardest problems in software: it touches every component, every developer, and every user, and it's historically been slow, manual, and reactive. The Component Accessibility Team (CAT) is changing that. **We improve accessibility by focusing on the developer experience: we build AI tools that shift accessibility as far left as possible, so developers don't have to be accessibility experts to write perfectly accessible code.**  
  
We build the accessibility agent as a *product* : the knowledge, the fix tools, and the evaluation systems that let any Salesforce engineer request and receive accessible code suggestions in the flow of their work. Our tools ship into the surfaces developers already use: AI Expert Suite, DX MCP, Cursor, Claude Code, and Vibes. When a developer writes a component, we make it WCAG-compliant before the code makes it to production.
  
  
This is a business problem, not only an ethical one. By improving accessibility at Salesforce we help win deals. It unlocks the features sales needs to close public-sector and enterprise contracts, and it protects Salesforce from a fast-growing wave of legal and regulatory risk. Accessibility serves the 1.3 billion people worldwide who live with disabilities, and it's increasingly a condition of doing business: ADA digital-accessibility lawsuits have increased every year since 2018, and VPAT conformance is now a standard requirement in enterprise and public-sector procurement. The US federal government can't buy software that fails Section 508, and the EU's European Accessibility Act extended the same bar to Europe in June 2025. Accessible-by-default code is how Salesforce keeps winning deals in the public sector, including with agencies that serve millions of veterans who have disabilities.
  
  
The CAT accessibility product is already running at scale. Our Prizm PR-review presubmit is live on core and offcore and has reviewed 42,845 pull requests since late May.
